crossRefs.note: When your days are fulfilled, and you sleep with your fathers, I will set up your offspring after you, who will proceed…
Otherwise it will happen, when my lord the king sleeps with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon will be considered…
Jehoahaz slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria; and Joash his son reigned in his place.
Joash slept with his fathers; and Jeroboam sat on his throne. Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.
Yahweh’s word that came to Hosea the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah…
The words of Amos, who was among the herdsmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of…
Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, “Amos has conspired against you in the…
For Amos says, ‘Jeroboam will die by the sword, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of his land.’ ”

parallels.note: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria; and Ahab his son reigned in his place.

translations.web: Jehoash slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel; and Jeroboam his son reigned in his place.
translations.bsb: And Jehoash rested with his fathers and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel. And his son Jeroboam reigned in his place.
